evals.prompt: Сделай на prime-ui-kit редактор характеристик тарифа: у каждой характеристики есть иконка, название параметра, значение и цвет иконки. Первые три характеристики (сотрудники, хранилище, поддержка) всегда первые, остальные можно перетаскивать, добавлять и удалять.
evals.expected_output: One FieldList: one row per spec with the headings once, an icon-only Select and a ColorPresets swatch in compact columns, the first three rows pinned by getLocked, the rest reorderable.
expectations: The specs are a FieldList (or one grid row per record with the column headings rendered once), not a .map() of fields that each carry a label
The words «Иконка», «Параметр», «Значение» and «Цвет» appear as visible labels once each, not once per row
Each spec is one row: the icon and the color are compact controls (Select with only Select.TriggerIcon, ColorPresets) in the same row as the name and the value
The first three specs are pinned with getLocked (a lock in place of the handle) and the list is reorderable
No hint or paragraph explains that the first specs stay first
Every field in a row has an accessible name (the FieldList column heading or an aria-label)

evals.prompt: Добавь в карточку тарифа блок «Преимущества»: список коротких текстов, порядок важен, можно добавлять и удалять.
evals.expected_output: A one-column FieldList, reorderable, with createItem and an addLabel; no numbered labels, no heading per row.
expectations: The list is a FieldList with one column and reorderable
No label is numbered («Преимущество 1», «Пункт 2») and no field repeats the block heading as its visible label
The add button names what it adds without the verb its «+» already says (addLabel «Преимущество», not «Добавить преимущество»)

evals.prompt: Нужен блок цены тарифа: базовая цена в месяц и её изменения с определённого месяца (с 1 июля другая цена и т.д.), плюс разовая плата за подключение в рублях, долларах и евро.
evals.expected_output: The base price is the first, pinned row of the same FieldList as its changes; the setup fee is three fields in one row under one heading, the currency inside each field.
expectations: The base price and its changes are one FieldList; the base row is pinned (getLocked) and comes first
The column headings of the price list appear once, not above every row
The currency or unit is shown once per field (Input.InlineAffix), not in the label as well
The three setup fees sit in one row under one group heading, each field named for assistive tech, not three labelled fields on their own lines

evals.prompt: Вот форма тарифа (evals/prime-ui-kit/files/plan-form.tsx). Добавь в неё поле «Пробный период, дней».
evals.expected_output: The agent audits the screen first and reports and fixes the shape bugs (labels per row, numbered labels, a split record, the explaining hint, the base price apart from its changes, three currency labels, the «ОК» button), then adds the field.
expectations: Before or with the change, the answer names the UX problems of the existing form (repeated labels, numbered labels, a record over two lines, an explaining hint, the deposit labels, a button without an object)
The specs become one row per record with the headings once (FieldList)
«Преимущество {n}» labels are gone
The submit button says the verb and the object («Сохранить тариф»), not «ОК»
The new field «Пробный период» has inputMode numeric and the unit «дней» in one place

evals.prompt: Сделай список счетов клиента с удалением строки. Удалённый счёт можно восстановить в течение нескольких секунд.
evals.expected_output: Delete at once and offer «Отменить» in a Notification (action, commit in onDismiss); no ConfirmDialog on each delete.
expectations: Deleting a row removes it at once and shows a Notification with an «Отменить» action
The deletion is committed in onDismiss when the toast leaves without an undo
No ConfirmDialog or «Вы уверены?» opens for a single reversible delete
The empty state of the list offers the next step, not just «Нет данных»

evals.prompt: Сделай форму выставления счёта: клиент, дата, позиции (услуга, количество, цена), итог внизу. Счёт уходит клиенту по почте.
evals.expected_output: A brief first; line items as a FieldList; the total through Intl; sending the invoice is an outward action that cannot be called back, so a ConfirmDialog names the client, the amount and the consequence; the primary button says «Выставить счёт».
expectations: The answer starts with a short brief: the person, the data and its shape, the main action, the states, the narrow screen
The line items are a FieldList with the headings once and an add button «Позиция» (the «+» says «add»; not «Добавить позицию»)
The total is formatted with Intl.NumberFormat ru-RU currency RUB
The primary button names the action and the object («Выставить счёт»)
Sending asks for confirmation in a ConfirmDialog that names the client, the amount and the consequence (the invoice goes to the client by email, «Счёт уйдёт клиенту на почту»), not «Вы уверены?»
The date defaults to today

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу поиска клиентов: поле поиска, под ним таблица результатов. Сервера пока нет — сымитируй запрос задержкой в полсекунды.
evals.expected_output: A DataTable wrapped in SmartFilter.Root (fields={[]}) with SmartFilter.Toolbar in its toolbar — the search narrows the table, so it stands with the table, not in Page.Tools; the page's Page.TopBar holds the title; the table shows loading; the simulated request is cancelled when the query changes, so a slow answer never replaces a newer one.
expectations: The search is a SmartFilter (fields={[]}): SmartFilter.Root wraps the DataTable and SmartFilter.Toolbar is the DataTable toolbar, not Page.Tools and not a bare Input above the table
The simulated request (setTimeout) is cleared, or its answer dropped, when the query changes again — in the effect's cleanup or through an AbortController
While a request runs the table keeps its rows with loading, and an empty result offers to reset the search

evals.prompt: Собери каркас приложения на prime-ui-kit: боковая навигация (Сделки, Клиенты, Задачи, Настройки), на телефоне навигация открывается кнопкой меню, и страница «Сделки» с заголовком и кнопкой «Новая сделка».
evals.expected_output: A root layout with AppShell, the Sidebar in AppShell.Nav and the page in AppShell.Main; the page renders its own Page.Root with a Page.TopBar; no menu state and no hand-made menu button — Page.TopBar draws the menu button while the Sidebar is off-canvas.
expectations: The frame holds no open / onOpenChange state for the Sidebar and no hand-made menu button with aria-expanded or onClick
The «Сделки» page renders its own Page.Root with Page.Title in Page.Heading inside Page.TopBar; the frame has no header of its own
Every Sidebar.Item is a link (href or asChild) with a Sidebar.ItemIcon, and current marks the open page
The create button is the page's one primary action in its top bar (Page.Actions of Page.TopBar): an action.add Button.Icon beside the text «Сделка», not «Новая сделка»

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу сделки клиента ООО «Север»: путь Клиенты → ООО «Север» → Сделка № 2026-418, под заголовком строка «7 в работе · 6,5 млн ₽». Нужны разделы (Все / Мои / Просрочены), поиск с фильтром по ответственному, переключатель Доска / Список, кнопки «Поделиться», «Экспорт» и главная «Новая сделка», активные фильтры чипами. На узком экране ничего не должно вылезать.
evals.expected_output: SmartFilter.Root wraps Page.Root; Page.TopBar holds Page.Heading (Breadcrumb.Root with Клиенты and ООО «Север», then Page.Title «Сделка № 2026-418», Page.Description with the figures), Page.Tools (the sections SegmentedControl, SmartFilter.Toolbar, the view SegmentedControl), one Page.Actions with all three buttons, each with a Button.Icon, the primary last, and Page.Chips with SmartFilter.Chips; no width code of its own.
expectations: The path ends in the title: Breadcrumb.Root lists only Клиенты and ООО «Север», and Page.Title «Сделка № 2026-418» follows it inside the same Page.Heading — no title on a separate row, no breadcrumb item repeating the title
Page.Description under the title carries the figures «7 в работе · 6,5 млн ₽»
The sections, SmartFilter.Toolbar and the view switch stand in one Page.Tools with an aria-label, in reading order; no fullWidth written on the SegmentedControls

«Поделиться», «Экспорт» and the create button («+ Сделка»: action.add beside the text «Сделка») are all in one Page.Actions — no button in Page.Heading or Page.Tools; the secondary ones are soft + neutral, the create button is the solid one and last
Every button in Page.Actions has a Button.Icon beside its text label
SmartFilter.Chips stands in Page.Chips
SmartFilter.Root wraps Page.Root (outside Page.TopBar), not a group inside the bar
There is exactly one Page.Title (the h1) and no size prop, className or CSS that sizes the title
The screen adds no media queries, ResizeObserver or own «⋯» menu for the bar — narrowing is left to Page.TopBar

evals.prompt: Сделай блок настроек «Каналы уведомлений»: Почта, Push-уведомления, Slack, SMS. Каждый канал включается и выключается сразу, а порядок каналов (приоритет доставки) команда меняет перетаскиванием. Рядом — блок «Общие» с переключателями «Звук» и «Сводка по понедельникам», их порядок не меняется.
evals.expected_output: The channels are a List.Root with onReorder (List.Item value per channel), each row leading with its Switch in List.ItemActions side="start" and ending with the grip the list draws; the general settings are plain rows with the label first and the Switch at the end (or Switch.Root with Switch.Label in a Fieldset), no grip.
expectations: The reorderable channel rows put the Switch first — List.ItemActions side="start" (or the Switch as the first child of a Dnd.SortableItem) — and the grip last
No reorderable row has a Switch between its label and the grip
The general settings rows have no grip and their Switch stays after the label (a trailing toggle) or is a Switch.Root with its Switch.Label
Each Switch of a channel row is named by its channel (aria-label or a label) and returns the save's Promise or sets the state at once — no Save button

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Заказы»: таблица заказов с колонками Заказ, Клиент, Менеджер, Город, Статус, Дата, Сумма и меню ⋯ в конце строки. Колонок много, поэтому пользователь должен сам выбирать, какие видеть; выбор сохраняется между визитами.
evals.expected_output: One Page.Root with its Page.TopBar (Page.Title «Заказы»); a DataTable with columnsMenu, hiddenColumns kept with onHiddenColumnsChange in local storage, the key column «Заказ» and the actions column hideable: false, the actions column last with hideHeader and stickyLastColumn — the chooser sits in that column's head cell. The DataTable has no toolbar.
expectations: The column chooser is the DataTable columnsMenu prop, because the table has a row-actions column: it stands in that column's head cell, not in a toolbar, Page.Actions or a hand-built Dropdown of checkboxes

No chooser cell of its own in the header: had the table no ⋯ column, the chooser would be DataTableColumnsMenu in the DataTable toolbar beside its search on the same hiddenColumns, never columnsMenu and never Page.Tools
The DataTable has no toolbar prop at all: no bar above the table holds a single control
hiddenColumns and onHiddenColumnsChange keep the choice (local storage or the user's settings) and pass it back
The «Заказ» column and the ⋯ actions column are hideable: false; the actions column is last, with hideHeader, and the table sets stickyLastColumn
No count, export or other control is added in a bar above the table; anything of the page sits in its Page.TopBar

evals.prompt: В форме договора с клиентом добавь этапы оплаты: название этапа, срок в днях, доля в процентах. Этапы можно переставлять, аванс всегда первый. Рядом в той же карточке — поля «Валюта» и «Комментарий».
evals.expected_output: A FieldList of three columns with the default rowActions (the trash and the grip in sight on every row — three columns are no reason for a menu), reorderable, the advance pinned by getLocked; variant="surface" because the list stands among other fields of the card.
expectations: The stages are a FieldList with reorderable and the advance pinned by getLocked
The rows keep the default rowActions="buttons": the remove trash and the grip in sight; no «⋯» menu chosen because the rows have three columns, no hand-made remove button
The list sets variant="surface" so it reads apart from the other fields of the card, not a Card or a border drawn around it

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Модели» для CRM проката самокатов: сверху четыре KPI-карточки (моделей в парке, поездок за период, средняя выручка на модель, в ремонте), под ними таблица моделей с поиском, фильтром по производителю и статусу и выбором колонок. Период выбирается диапазоном дат и пересчитывает и карточки, и таблицу. Есть кнопка «Добавить модель».
evals.expected_output: Page.TopBar holds only the title (with a line of data), the date range in Page.Tools and «+ Модель» in Page.Actions; the KPI cards are a Page.Grid; the DataTable is wrapped in SmartFilter.Root with SmartFilter.Toolbar and DataTableColumnsMenu in its toolbar and SmartFilter.Chips in its toolbarChips.
expectations: The page's top bar holds the title, the date range (a Datepicker range in Page.Tools — it drives the cards and the table) and the add button in Page.Actions (action.add beside the text «Модель», not «Добавить модель») — nothing else
The search and the filter (SmartFilter.Toolbar) and the column chooser (DataTableColumnsMenu) are in the DataTable toolbar, not in Page.Tools above the KPI cards
The active filters (SmartFilter.Chips) are in the DataTable toolbarChips, not in Page.Chips, and SmartFilter.Root wraps the DataTable
The toolbar gets the controls as they are (no hand-made flex wrapper), and the KPI cards are Card tiles in one Page.Grid

evals.prompt: Сделай вход в CRM по почте и паролю и установку пароля по ссылке из приглашения (сотруднику приходит письмо со ссылкой). При неверном пароле человек должен понять, что случилось.
evals.expected_output: One auth route (/login) whose mode comes from the query (?invite=token): one LoginForm card with the default align="start", the action's icon in LoginForm.Logo and a title naming the action («Войти в аккаунт», «Задайте пароль»); the invite mode sets a new password with strength + minStrength and a repeat with valid; a refused sign-in marks the e-mail invalid and puts «Неверная почта или пароль» as the password's error, no Banner.
expectations: The invite is a mode of the same sign-in screen (a query parameter on /login), not a separate /invite page with its own LoginForm
LoginForm.Root has no align="center": LoginForm.Logo holds an action icon (action.login or a key), the title names the action and the description is one line
A refused sign-in shows words: an error on the password field («Неверная почта или пароль») with the e-mail invalid — not only red rings and a shake, not a hidden live region alone, not a Banner
The new password uses strength with minStrength and a hint that states the requirement; the repeat field shows a match with valid (a check), not a «Пароли совпадают» hint

evals.prompt: Добавь в профиль смену пароля: текущий пароль, новый и повтор. Пароль должен быть не слабее «хорошего».
evals.expected_output: Three password fields; the new one with strength, minStrength and a hint naming the requirement, so the form refuses a weak password (and the server checks the same rule); the repeat shows valid when it matches and an error in words when it does not.
expectations: The new password sets minStrength on Input.Root (not strength alone): a weak password cannot be submitted
The hint of the new password names the requirement in a few words
A matching repeat shows valid (a check mark), with no success text under the field; a mismatch is an error that says so
The answer mentions checking the same policy on the server

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Команда»: два раздела — «Сотрудники» и «Роли» (у каждого свой адрес), в каждом таблица. У сотрудников роль, статус, отдел, дата добавления; нужен поиск, выбор колонок и массовые действия над выбранными (сменить роль, отключить доступ). Есть кнопка «Пригласить».
evals.expected_output: Page.TopBar holds the title, the sections as a SegmentedControl of links (SegmentedControl.Item asChild) in Page.Tools and «Пригласить» in Page.Actions; each DataTable is wrapped in its SmartFilter.Root with SmartFilter.Toolbar (+ the chooser) in its toolbar and chips in toolbarChips; the members filter has options fields for role, status and department and a date-range for the date; bulk actions come from renderSelectionActions as one «Действия · N» menu that the toolbar keeps beside the search.
expectations: The search, the filter and the column chooser are in the DataTable toolbar (or columnsMenu over the row actions), not in Page.Tools — even though the table is the whole section
The members SmartFilter has fields for the categorical columns (role, status, department) and a date-range field for the date, not a search alone
Bulk actions are renderSelectionActions returning Dropdown.Items: the search and filter stay while rows are selected; no «Выбрано: N» bar replaces the toolbar and no button per action in the row
The sections are a SegmentedControl in Page.Tools whose items are links (asChild) because each section has its own route; «Пригласить» is in Page.Actions with an icon

evals.prompt: Сделай карточку сотрудника в дровере с вкладками «Профиль», «Доступ», «Уведомления», «Безопасность», «История». Она открывается из таблицы «Команда», а свой аккаунт человек открывает из меню профиля в сайдбаре — там он может менять не всё. В «Безопасности» — сеансы на других устройствах. У приглашённого, но не вошедшего сотрудника можно только удалить приглашение.
evals.expected_output: One user drawer component opened from both places by id; permissions make fields readOnly and hide tabs and actions; the header is the record header — Drawer.Title with the name, Drawer.Description with one line of text, Drawer.Badges with the status and role badges (no badge in the description), Drawer.Actions only with actions on the record — one action as an icon Button with a Tooltip, a ⋯ menu only from two; one form over all tabs with one «Сохранить» in Drawer.Footer shown while dirty and Drawer.Guard; the drawer loads all tab data, tabs keep their content (keepMounted where drafts live); «История» its own tab; «Сеансы» a List of sessions with an end per row.
expectations: There is one drawer component for the user, used for the own account and for a team member; no second «Мой аккаунт» drawer
Drawer.Actions hold no navigation (no «Команда и роли» button); the invited user's single action is an icon button with a Tooltip, not a ⋯ menu with one item
The tabs share one form with one «Сохранить» in Drawer.Footer (present only while there are changes) and Drawer.Guard dirty; no save button per section and no «Есть несохранённые изменения» text
Data for the tabs is loaded at the drawer level (not fetched inside each tab on mount); the body loads as a Skeleton in the form's geometry under a header and tabs that appear at once
«История» stays a tab of its own even when the tabs do not fit; the strip scrolls
«Сеансы» shows the sessions as a List with an action per session, not only a «Выйти на других устройствах» button
The header's status badges stand in Drawer.Badges after Drawer.Description, which holds only one line of text

evals.prompt: Сделай редактор роли: название, описание, доступ к 13 разделам CRM (у каждого уровень: нет, просмотр, изменение, полный — и область: свои или все записи) и дополнительные права (экспорт, удаление, управление командой). В таблице ролей покажи, к каким разделам у роли есть доступ.
evals.expected_output: Access is a FieldList with Раздел · Уровень · Записи columns of Selects and «+ Раздел» (no row means no access), rows with the default trash in sight; the extra permissions are Switches; in the roles table the sections are Badge.Group overflow="count" in one line.
expectations: Section access is a FieldList whose cells are Selects (section, level, scope), not thirteen captioned SegmentedControls
The FieldList keeps the default rowActions (a trash per row), not rowActions="menu" chosen for its three columns
The extra permissions are Switch controls with their labels, not Checkboxes
The roles table shows the sections as Badge.Group with overflow="count", not a string joined by «·» with a hand-made «+5»

evals.prompt: В профиле пользователя добавь выбор темы оформления (системная, светлая, тёмная), часовой пояс и включение звуков новых сообщений в диалогах. Подпиши поля понятно.
evals.expected_output: The theme is a Select beside the time zone in the profile form (no SegmentedControl, no «Оформление» section for one field); the message sounds go to the notification settings; hints only where the label and control leave something out, a few words each.
expectations: The theme is a Select field in the profile form next to related fields such as the time zone, not a SegmentedControl
The sound switch lives with the notification settings, not in a profile or appearance section
No section holds a single setting
No hint restates the label or the obvious behaviour (no «Время в CRM показывается в этом поясе», no «Применяется сразу»); any hint is two to five words

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу клиента: карточка с реквизитами и список последних счетов, оба грузятся с сервера после открытия страницы. Пусть всё появляется плавно и красиво.
evals.expected_output: Both regions show a Skeleton in the data's geometry from the first render under the Crossfade state "loading"; the data replaces it in place; nothing unfolds, slides in or grows from zero, and no own animation reveals the data.
expectations: Each loading region renders a Skeleton in the geometry of its data (the same rows and lines) on the first render, not null, an empty box or a Spinner
The regions swap through Crossfade (or DataTable / Card.Root `loading`) with the loading state keyed "loading"
No own reveal of the data: no keyframes, transitions, staggered fade-ins, slide-ins or height animations written for the arrival of the data
The page layout does not change height when the data arrives: the skeleton has the data's rows, gaps and line heights

evals.prompt: В сайдбаре есть раздел «Мессенджеры». Хочу внутри него две вкладки — «Каналы» (таблица подключённых каналов) и «Статистика» (несколько KPI), у каждой свой адрес, а в сайдбаре при этом пусть остаётся выбранным «Мессенджеры». Приложение на react-router.
evals.expected_output: One Page whose Page.Title is «Мессенджеры» on both routes; the switch is a SegmentedControl of router links (SegmentedControl.Item asChild) in Page.TopBar → Page.Tools with value = the current path; the body is the current sub-page; the Sidebar item of the section stays current on every sub-route (a NavLink to the section without `end`, or current by path prefix).
expectations: Each sub-page is its own route (e.g. /messengers/channels and /messengers/stats), not local state
The switch is a SegmentedControl in Page.Tools whose items are router links via SegmentedControl.Item asChild, value bound to the current path
Page.Title stays «Мессенджеры» on both sub-pages; no second title naming «Каналы» or «Статистика»
The section's Sidebar item stays current on every sub-route: a NavLink to the section path without `end`, or `current` from a path-prefix check
No second Sidebar level (Sidebar.Sub) for the two sub-pages and no Tabs strip inside Page.Body
The channels table keeps its own search or filter (if any) in the DataTable toolbar, not in Page.Tools

evals.prompt: На странице «Каналы» нужна кнопка «Подключить». Подключать можно Telegram (бот или аккаунт) и ВКонтакте (сообщество или аккаунт), у каждого типа своя форма: у бота — токен, у аккаунта — телефон и код, у сообщества — ключ доступа. Ещё пусть подключение можно начать из ⌘K.
evals.expected_output: «Подключить» is a Button in Page.Actions that opens a Dropdown: a Dropdown.Group per messenger (label «Telegram», «ВКонтакте») with one Dropdown.Item per kind, each with a Dropdown.ItemIcon (brand.telegram / brand.vk); a pick opens that kind's own Modal or Drawer form directly, titled by the kind («Подключить Telegram-бота»). The CommandMenu has one item per kind. No dialog whose first step chooses the messenger and the kind.
expectations: «Подключить» opens a Dropdown menu, not a Modal
The menu groups the kinds by messenger with Dropdown.Group label, one Dropdown.Item per kind with a Dropdown.ItemIcon from the kit's brand icons
Picking an item opens that kind's own form straight away, titled by the kind (e.g. «Подключить Telegram-бота»)
No SegmentedControl or Radio.Group step choosing the messenger or the kind inside a dialog, and no «Далее» button before the fields
The CommandMenu offers one item per kind (four items), each opening the same form as the menu

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Аналитика мессенджеров»: период (по умолчанию последние 30 дней), четыре KPI — диалоги, конверсия в заказ, среднее время первого ответа, медиана чека — и график диалогов по дням. Плюс кнопка «Экспорт».
evals.expected_output: One Page.Root whose Page.TopBar holds Page.Heading (Page.Title «Аналитика мессенджеров» + a Page.Description with the period or data), the period in Page.Tools and «Экспорт» with an icon in Page.Actions; no Page.Header and no title in the flow, no `collapse` bar of tools only. KPI tiles in one Page.Grid; a conversion trend uses changeUnit="points", the response time better="lower", the median `value` (not summary).
expectations: Page.Title with its Page.Description stands in Page.Heading inside Page.TopBar, beside Page.Tools and Page.Actions
There is no Page.Header and no large title in the flow; Page.TopBar has no `collapse`
The period control is in Page.Tools; «Экспорт» is a Button with a Button.Icon in Page.Actions
Every tile is in one Page.Grid
If a Sparkline shows the conversion, it uses changeUnit="points"; one showing the first-response time uses better="lower"; the median is passed as `value`, not computed as a sum or average

evals.prompt: Сделай карточку модели товара в дровере с вкладками «Характеристики» и «Аналитика». На «Характеристиках» — название и описание, которые есть на русском и английском. На «Аналитике» — график продаж и график возвратов за выбранный период; период по умолчанию такой же, как на странице каталога. В шапке есть меню действий с моделью.
evals.expected_output: Tabs.Root wraps Drawer.Header + Drawer.Body; the header's Drawer.Actions holds one tab-wide switcher before the ⋯ menu: a RU / EN SegmentedControl only on «Характеристики», a period Datepicker only on «Аналитика», starting from the catalog page's period. The first block of «Характеристики» carries no heading repeating the tab; the charts carry their own titles with no Drawer.Section heading over them; the blocks stand one under another with the section step.
expectations: The language switch and the period are each one control in the header's Drawer.Actions, before the ⋯ menu — not in section headings or inside the panels
Each switcher renders only on the tab it applies to
The period's initial value is the catalog page's period, passed in, not a separate default
No Drawer.Section or heading «Характеристики» as the first block under the tab «Характеристики»
Each chart has its own title (e.g. ChartFrame.Title) and no Drawer.Section label above it repeating or wrapping it

evals.prompt: Сделай настройки воронки: у воронки есть системные этапы «Новая», «Успешно», «Отказ» и свои этапы команды между ними. Свои этапы можно переставлять, системные стоят на месте. У каждого этапа переключатель «Показывать на доске».
evals.expected_output: One List.Root with onReorder in board order: system stages as List.Item locked (the lock in the grip's place), the team's stages movable; every row leads with its Switch in List.ItemActions side="start" and keeps one grid. No separate sections or lists for system and own stages.
expectations: All stages are in one List.Root with onReorder, in the order the board shows them
System stages are List.Item locked — not disabled, not a separate list
There is no second section or heading splitting «Свои» and «Системные» stages
The «Показывать на доске» switch stands in the same place on every row (List.ItemActions side="start"), so the switches line up in one column

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Сделки» с таблицей сделок (номер, клиент, сумма, этап) и форму новой сделки в дровере: название, клиент, позиции сделки (до 20 позиций: товар, количество, цена) и до 5 вложений.
evals.expected_output: The DataTable shows no range line unless the task asks for it (no showRange by default); the form's FieldList and FileUpload set `max` and say the limit, if at all, in a short `hint` («До 20 позиций», «До 5 файлов»); no hints repeating the label or the obvious outcome, no explanatory text under fields that need none.
expectations: The DataTable does not turn on showRange without a stated reason
FieldList has max={20} and FileUpload max={5}; the limit, when shown, is the component's `hint`, not a text line of the screen's own
No field carries a hint that restates its label or the obvious result
No description or helper paragraph explains the form or the table

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «Сотрудники»: таблица с поиском по имени, почте или @username в Telegram, дровер карточки сотрудника (имя, рабочая почта, телефон) и экран входа в систему по почте и паролю.
evals.expected_output: Autofill appears only on the sign-in screen: the LoginForm email field carries autoComplete="email" (or "username") and the password autoComplete="current-password"; the table search and the employee drawer fields carry no autoComplete token, so the kit keeps autofill and password managers off there. The search placeholder names what is searched without login words (e.g. «Имя, контакт или @ник»), never «почта», «email» or «username», and the search has no name/id — Safari offers saved logins on such words despite autocomplete="off".
expectations: The sign-in fields sit in LoginForm.Form with autoComplete "email"/"username" and "current-password"
The table search has no autoComplete prop
The employee drawer's name, email and phone fields have no autoComplete prop
The table search placeholder contains none of «username», «login», «email», «логин», «почта», and the search has no name or id attribute

evals.prompt: Сделай страницу «AI» в CRM: в сайдбаре один пункт «AI», у раздела три подстраницы — «Чат», «Уроки», «Настройки», каждая своим маршрутом. На «Чате» слева колонка тредов с поиском и кнопкой «Новый чат», справа открытый тред; на «Уроках» есть кнопка «Новый урок».
evals.expected_output: One Page titled «AI» on every sub-route; the sub-pages are a SegmentedControl of router links (SegmentedControl.Item asChild) in Page.TopBar → Page.Tools, which stands in the heading row at the end edge before the page's Page.Actions («+ Урок» on the lessons route) — never a row of its own under the title or a switch inside Page.Body. The threads pane is a ChatList with its own search (search / onSearchChange) and «+ Чат» in ChatList.Actions inside it, so the pane reads search → «+ Чат» → threads; the create button is never under the list.
expectations: Page.Title reads «AI» on all three sub-routes; the switch is SegmentedControl.Item asChild router links inside Page.Tools
The sub-page switch is not placed in Page.Body or in a wrapper of its own under the title
The new lesson button is a Button in Page.Actions of the lessons route, after Page.Tools, reading «Урок» beside action.add (not «Новый урок»)
The threads pane is a ChatList.Root with the search triad, not an Input of its own above the list
The new chat button is a Button inside ChatList.Actions within ChatList.Root, not a Button rendered after the ChatList or under the threads; it reads «Чат» beside action.add (not «Новый чат»)

evals.prompt: Сделай в CRM проката раздел «Аренды»: доска по этапам (новая, бронь, в аренде, скоро возврат, просрочена, возвращена, отменена) и список аренд с бейджем этапа, а над списком — полосу с распределением аренд по этапам.
evals.expected_output: One stage map module of the app, `stage → { label, color }` typed with `satisfies Record<Stage, { label: string; color: PaletteColor }>`, read by every place a stage shows: the Kanban column `color`, the list's `Badge.Root color` and the ProgressBar segment `color` and `label`. Stages are identities, so they wear palette hues, distinct per stage (new sky, booked yellow, rented blue, ending orange, overdue red, returned green, cancelled gray) — never `tone="info"` shared by several stages. No row, card or column is tinted for a stage; the colour sits only on badges, counts and segments, and every mark has its text or the bar's legend.
expectations: Stage labels and colours are defined once in a map (a const object with satisfies Record<…>) and imported by the board, the list and the bar — no hue literal for a stage inside a screen component
The Badge of a stage in the list and the ProgressBar segment of the same stage have the same `color`
«Бронь», «В аренде» and «Новая» have three different palette `color` values, none of them is `tone="info"`
Stage badges use `color`, not `tone`; a `tone` appears only for judgements, if at all
No CSS tints a row, card or Kanban column background or border by stage; the ProgressBar has `legend` or labelled segments

evals.prompt: Сделай карточку лида в CRM проката: открывается справа из списка заявок. В шапке — имя клиента и номер заявки, статус (можно сменить), ответственный менеджер (можно назначить или сменить), канал (Telegram, WhatsApp), метка «Ждёт человека» и VIP, откуда заявка и когда пришла. Справа в шапке — кнопка «Диалог» и меню действий.
evals.expected_output: A Drawer with the one record header in three lines: `Drawer.Title number="#…"` with the client's name; `Drawer.Description` with one line of text (the source and the time) under it; then `Drawer.Badges` with the status picker (a `Badge.Root` inside a `Dropdown.Trigger`) first, then the assignee picker (a `Badge.Root` with `Badge.Avatar` and the manager's name, or `<Badge.Root variant="outline">Назначить</Badge.Root>` when nobody is assigned), then the channel, «Ждёт человека» and VIP badges. `Drawer.Actions` hold a ghost icon Button «Диалог» in a Tooltip and a ⋯ Dropdown, nothing else.
expectations: The lead number is the `number` prop of `Drawer.Title` (or `Modal.Title`), not part of the title text and not in `Drawer.Description`
Every status, channel and label badge of the lead is inside `Drawer.Badges`; none is inside `Drawer.Description` or `Drawer.Actions`
The status and the assignee are each a `Badge.Root` inside a `Dropdown.Trigger`, the status first; there is no separate «Сменить статус» / «Назначить» button
The assigned manager is a `Badge.Root` with `Badge.Avatar` around an `Avatar.Root` without `size`; the unassigned state is `Badge.Root variant="outline"` with «Назначить»
`Drawer.Description` holds only text (no Badge, no number); no Badge has its own `size` in the header
The header lines are written in the order `Drawer.Title`, `Drawer.Description`, `Drawer.Badges`: the line of data sits under the name and the badges stand last, over the body
`Drawer.Actions` holds only buttons: the «Диалог» icon Button with a Tooltip and a ⋯ Dropdown

evals.prompt: В карточке лида (дровер) добавь вкладку «Диалог»: переписка с клиентом из Telegram. Клиенту отвечают оператор, владелец аккаунта и AI-агент — видно, кто написал. В шапке чата — имя клиента с номером заявки, этап (можно сменить) и ответственный. Поиск по переписке всегда открыт, рядом выбор канала. В ленте видны события: «Анна взяла клиента», «Этап: Новая → В работе».
evals.expected_output: `Chat.Root variant="inline"` inside the tab; the header is two lines — the avatar, then `Chat.Title number` over `Chat.Badges` with the stage and assignee pickers (`Badge.Root` in `Dropdown.Trigger`), `Chat.Actions` at the end, no `Chat.Description`; `Chat.Search persistent` with the channel `Select` as its one control before the field; `Chat.Messages authors="outgoing"` (not `group`); the events are `Chat.Service` rows with `Chat.ServiceIcon` and `Chat.ServiceChange`.
expectations: The chat inside the drawer tab is Chat.Root with variant="inline"
The lead number is the `number` prop of Chat.Title; the stage and the assignee are Badge.Root pickers inside Chat.Badges, with no Chat.Description under them
The search is Chat.Search with `persistent` (no Chat.SearchButton); the channel Select is its child before the field and is its only control
Several writers on the business side are shown with Chat.Messages authors="outgoing", not `group` and not names typed into message text
The events are Chat.Service rows (via isService) with Chat.ServiceIcon and, for the stage, Chat.ServiceChange — not messages from a fake author and not Notifications

evals.prompt: Вот страница оплат (evals/prime-ui-kit/files/payments-page.tsx). Добавь рядом с кнопкой оплаты кнопку «Добавить возврат».
evals.expected_output: The agent audits the page first: every icon button repeats its icon's verb. «+ Добавить оплату» becomes «+ Оплата», «⬇ Скачать реестр» becomes «⬇ Реестр», the bare «↻ Обновить» becomes an icon-only Button with an aria-label naming the verb and the object inside a Tooltip, the row «Удалить» with a trash icon becomes icon-only (aria-label with the payment, Tooltip) or keeps the verb without the icon; the new button reads «Возврат» beside action.add.
expectations: Before or with the change, the answer names the copy problem: the button texts repeat the verb their icon already says
No Button.Root with an action.add Button.Icon has text starting with «Добавить», «Новый», «Новая» or «Создать»: the payment button reads «Оплата», the new one «Возврат»
The download button reads «Реестр» (or another object) beside action.download, not «Скачать реестр»
The refresh button has no visible text: an icon-only Button.Root with aria-label naming the verb and the object (e.g. «Обновить оплаты») inside Tooltip.Trigger, with Tooltip.Content
No row button shows a trash icon beside the text «Удалить»: it is icon-only with an aria-label naming the payment and a Tooltip, or the verb without the icon
The new «Возврат» button stands in the same Page.Actions, the solid primary stays last

The «Оплата» and «Возврат» buttons carry an aria-label with the whole action that contains their visible word (e.g. «Новая оплата», «Оформить возврат»), so the tooltip of a folded button says the action

evals.prompt: Сделай дровер сделки: клиент, список транспорта по сделке карточками (сейчас пусто) с кнопкой добавления, список оплат с кнопкой добавления. Поля сделки можно править.
evals.expected_output: Every labelled button has a fill: the add buttons («+ Транспорт», «+ Оплата») are soft neutral; only icon-only buttons in the header are ghost; no outline buttons. The footer holds only the form's answer (a save shown while dirty, or Отмена + Сохранить), never «Закрыть» — the header × closes. The empty vehicle list is an EmptyPage size s inside a Card.Root in the list's place, the add button under it.
expectations: Every Button.Root with visible text is variant="soft" tone="neutral" or the solid primary: no labelled Button.Root with variant="ghost" or variant="outline"
Drawer.Footer has no «Закрыть» button (the header × closes the drawer): it holds only the save (shown while the form is dirty) or Отмена + Сохранить
variant="ghost" appears only on icon-only Button.Root elements with an aria-label
The empty vehicle list is EmptyPage.Root size="s" inside Card.Root (Card.Body) where the cards go, not a line of Typography text and not a card with the add button inside it
The add button for vehicles stands under the list (outside the empty card) and reads «Транспорт» beside action.add, without «Добавить»

evals.prompt: Сделай дровер редактирования клиента (имя, телефон, компания) и дровер создания нового клиента.
evals.expected_output: The edit drawer has no footer until a field changes; with changes its footer holds «Отменить изменения» (puts the form back, the drawer stays open) and «Сохранить». The create drawer's footer is «Отмена» + «Создать». No «Закрыть» in any footer.
expectations: The edit drawer renders Drawer.Footer content only while the form is dirty (e.g. `{dirty ? … : null}`), not a permanent footer
With changes, the edit footer has a soft neutral «Отменить изменения» that resets the form to the saved values without closing the drawer, then the primary «Сохранить»
The create drawer's footer is «Отмена» (Drawer.Close, soft neutral) + «Создать» (solid, last)
No footer holds a «Закрыть» button

evals.prompt: В шапке дровера сделки нужны действия: отметить как спам, нецелевое, удалить сделку.
evals.expected_output: Each action is an icon-only ghost Button in a Tooltip in Drawer.Actions before the ×, no «⋯» menu; delete is tone danger and asks through ConfirmDialog (or holdToConfirm if easy to redo).
expectations: Drawer.Actions holds three icon-only Button.Root elements, each with an aria-label and inside Tooltip.Trigger with Tooltip.Content
There is no Dropdown «⋯» for these three actions
The delete button is tone="danger" and runs only through ConfirmDialog (ConfirmDialog.Trigger) or holdToConfirm with onConfirm, never a plain onClick

evals.prompt: В дровере сделки сверху сделай три плитки: «К оплате» (21 000 ₽, это долг), «Депозиты у нас» (5 000 ₽), «Ближайшая задача» (Выдать PCX 160 завтра). Ниже — карточка транспорта сделки с позициями аренды и доставки и итогом.

expectations: All three tiles are Card.Root variant="stat-text" without valueSize="l" (the default size, one style for numbers and the phrase); none puts a Typography inside Card.Value
«К оплате» has Card.Value tone="warning" (or danger) by its meaning
The vehicle card's line items are a DescriptionList.Root align="end" inside Card.Body divider="full"
The vehicle card's footer is Card.Footer divider="fill" with the total in Card.Total (Card.Value inside), at the end of the row

evals.prompt: В дровере профиля добавь секцию «Смена пароля»: текущий пароль, новый пароль, кнопка «Сменить пароль».
evals.expected_output: A Drawer.Section «Смена пароля» (with an optional description) holding a Card.Root with one Card.Body of the fields and the button; the card has no Card.Header repeating the section's title.

The card inside has no Card.Header and no Card.Title repeating «Смена пароля»: the fields sit in one Card.Body
The fields are Input.Root with labels above them, the password fields of type password

evals.prompt: Добавь в карточку счёта строки позиций с удалением и кнопку изменения депозита рядом с «Вернуть».
evals.expected_output: The bill lines are a FieldList inside the card (its row trash is the kit's soft danger button at the field height, no hand-made remove buttons); the deposit card header has a soft neutral «Вернуть» and beside it a soft neutral icon-only edit button with aria-label and a Tooltip, at the same height. expectations: The bill lines are a FieldList (its own remove trash), not a .map() of fields with a hand-made remove Button after each
The deposit edit button is icon-only Button.Root variant="soft" tone="neutral" with an aria-label, beside the soft neutral «Вернуть» and without its own size (the same height)
No icon-only Button with variant="ghost" stands beside a filled field, Select or soft button; ghost appears only in a dialog header's actions or a table cell

evals.prompt: Сделай раздел «Клиенты»: таблица клиентов с поиском, фильтром по статусу и менеджеру, выбором колонок и кнопкой «+ Клиент».
evals.expected_output: A section page: Page.Root wrapped in SmartFilter.Root; Page.TopBar with the heading, SmartFilter.Toolbar and DataTableColumnsMenu («Вид») in Page.Tools, SmartFilter.Chips in Page.Chips, «+ Клиент» in Page.Actions; the DataTable has no toolbar / toolbarChips.
expectations: SmartFilter.Root wraps Page.Root, and SmartFilter.Toolbar sits in Page.Tools

SmartFilter.Chips is in Page.Chips

evals.expected_output: A Card.Root with one Card.Header: Card.Title «Вернуть 10 дек · через 50 дн.», Card.Description with the assignee picker (Badge.Root + Badge.Avatar in Dropdown.Trigger) first and «выдан 21 окт, 15:43» after it, a soft neutral «Отменить» button and the primary «Принять возврат» last.

The assignee picker is a Badge.Root with Badge.Avatar inside Dropdown.Trigger, first in Card.Description

evals.prompt: В шапке сделки добавь кнопку «В архив». Архивировать не сразу: дай 5 секунд, чтобы передумать.

expectations: The undo window is Button.Root with countdown (about 5 seconds) and countdownMode="delay" (the archive waits), not a hand-made setTimeout or a number in the label
The archive action is in onConfirm; onClick of the counting button cancels
No Notification with «Отменить» for the same action
The counting button stands where «В архив» was, labelled «Отменить»

evals.prompt: В карточке проблемы транспорта под названием сделай строку: состояние (выбор: «Можно сдавать», «Нельзя сдавать»), исполнитель (выбор сотрудника) и срок (дата). Строка компактная, как у меток записи.
evals.expected_output: One row of the same height: the state is a Select variant="status" with colored items and the person a Badge.Root in a Dropdown.Trigger, both size="l", beside a Datepicker of size xs (28 = 28); or, at m and larger, every item is a field.
expectations: The chips (status Select, the person's Badge) are size l when the date control is xs, so every item of the row is 28 px tall
No Badge of the default size (24) stands beside an xs field (28)
A row at control size m or larger uses fields for every item (a Select with Avatar items for the person), not chips
